properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenVPN derives data-channel keys from the TLS master secret with the TLS 1.0 PRF (MD5-SHA1 concatenation) on the OpenSSL backend (crypto_openssl.c: EVP_KDF/EVP_PKEY tls1-prf with md5_sha1); the mbedTLS backends re-implement the same PRF. Weak, quantum-vulnerable hash in a live KDF; OpenVPN protocol mandates this PRF for key-method 2 key expansion

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live AES-CBC data-channel support: CBC mode queries (cipher_kt_mode_cbc) in both backends; integrity relies on the separate HMAC layer rather than AEAD (rating C reflects unauthenticated CBC). AES-128/256-CBC remain selectable via --cipher and appear in NCP/compat lists. Not Shor-relevant

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live data-channel mode support: backends expose cipher_kt_mode_ofb_cfb/cipher_ctx_mode_ofb_cfb queries (crypto_backend.h:298/397, implementations in both mbedTLS layers); ssl.c:1646 selects long packet-id form for OFB/CFB ciphers; tls_crypt.c:52 hardcodes the tls-crypt key type AES-256-CTR + HMAC-SHA256 (create_kt). CTR/CFB/OFB data ciphers are selectable via --cipher

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 as the MAC half of the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD data cipher: crypto_openssl.c:733/795/915 branch on NID_chacha20_poly1305 to special-case the AEAD (implicit MAC, no separate HMAC); :281 is the name-translation pair for NCP; remaining sites are unit tests of that support. Strong AEAD, Grover-only, not Shor-relevant

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 SIGNATURE padding, not encryption: management_query_pk_sig / xkey_helper build "RSA_PKCS1_PADDING" strings that tell the management interface or xkey OpenSSL-3 provider which padding to use when signing with an external (PKCS#11/management) RSA key; quantum-vulnerable signature scheme, migration ML-DSA. The 'encryption' label is a misread of the padding constant

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: gen-sample-keys.sh generates a secp256k1 EC key and CSR (sample-ca/secp256k1.pem) to exercise OpenVPN's support for that curve in certs; secp256k1 is quantum-vulnerable and unusual for TLS. Sample material, changeable here

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA private key support for the OpenVPN TLS context: enables RSA certificates, RSA signatures and (legacy) static-RSA key exchange; quantum-vulnerable (Shor), migration ML-DSA/ML-KEM

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: gen-sample-keys.sh creates the sample CA: self-signed RSA-4096 certificate, 10-year validity, no passphrase. The CA signs the sample client/server certs used across tests and sample configs; quantum-vulnerable CA key, migration ML-DSA/SLH-DSA

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenVPN's xkey OpenSSL-3 provider registers the RSA-PSS:RSASSA-PSS keytype so signatures can be delegated to external keys (PKCS#11/management interface); RSA-PSS is quantum-vulnerable (Shor), migration ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sample/sample-keys/ffdhe2048.pem: static RFC 7919 ffdhe2048 DH parameters for the deprecated --dh option (used by sample configs/tests). 2048-bit finite-field DH ≈ 112-bit classical security and fully broken by Shor; OpenVPN 2.6+ prefers ECDHE and deprecates --dh. Changeable here (sample artifact)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live control-channel ECDH configuration: --ecdh-curve option parsing (options.c:7210), curve selection with secp384r1 fallback (ssl_openssl.c:724-761, EC_KEY_new_by_curve_name), mbedTLS default-curve path (ssl_mbedtls.c:510). The majority of the 80 sites are ECDHE/ECDH suite-name literals in the ssl_util.c name-translation table — naming surface for --tls-cipher, not configuration by themselves. Net posture: OpenVPN's TLS control channel negotiates classic ECDHE (P-256/P-384/X25519 etc.) with NO

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live ECDSA support: EC certificates and ECDSA signatures on the control channel, external signing via management interface (ssl_openssl.c:1611 get_sig_from_man "ECDSA") and Windows CNG (cryptoapi.c:362); keytype naming at ssl_openssl.c:2426. The ssl_util.c sites are ECDHE-ECDSA suite-name literals in the translation table. Quantum-vulnerable signature (Shor), migration ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signature support in OpenVPN's xkey OpenSSL-3 provider: xkey_provider.c:1164 registers the ED25519 keytype ("OpenVPN xkey Ed25519 Signature") for external-key signing via PKCS#11/management; xkey_helper.c:208 routes ED25519 signature requests. Quantum-vulnerable signature (Shor), migration ML-DSA or SLH-DSA

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 (secp256r1/prime256v1) is a supported and configurable ECDH group for the control-channel TLS and legacy --ecdh-curve: ssl_openssl.c:538/540 translate secp256r1→prime256v1 in the curve/group configuration path; ssl_mbedtls.c:347 is the IANA-name→mbedTLS-ID table consumed by the mbedTLS tls-groups implementation. Quantum-vulnerable key agreement; migration X25519+ML-KEM-768 hybrid

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 group support: ssl_mbedtls.c:358 maps the IANA name to the mbedTLS group ID for --tls-groups; ssl_openssl.c:2610 is help text for --show-tls/--show-groups explaining OpenSSL lists built-in curves and that X25519/X448 are supported but not enumerated. Default-negotiable ECDH group, quantum-vulnerable; migration hybrid X25519+ML-KEM-768

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: TLS 1.2 is the default minimum protocol version (--tls-version-min defaults to 1.2); ssl_openssl.c:207 returns TLS1_2_VERSION from the version-string parser; :2555 caps the diagnostic --show-tls listing at TLS 1.2 when tls13 is off. TLS 1.2 with classic ECDHE kx is harvest-now-decrypt-later vulnerable; migration TLS 1.3 + hybrid X25519MLKEM768

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed448 signature support in the xkey provider (registration "OpenVPN xkey Ed448 Signature" at xkey_provider.c:1163, dispatch at 1007/1013, keytype name at 110-111, helper routing at xkey_helper.c:208). Quantum-vulnerable signature, migration ML-DSA or SLH-DSA

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-384/P-521/brainpoolP384r1 are supported TLS groups: ssl_mbedtls.c entries are the IANA-name→ID table consumed by mbedTLS --tls-groups; ssl_openssl.c:757-761 is the live --ecdh-curve path that falls back to secp384r1 when the requested curve is unavailable. Quantum-vulnerable ECDH; migration hybrid + ML-KEM

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X448 group support, same surface as X25519: mbedTLS IANA group table (ssl_mbedtls.c:363) and the OpenSSL help text at ssl_openssl.c:2610 documenting built-in X448 support. Quantum-vulnerable key agreement; migration hybrid X448+ML-KEM

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live AES-GCM data-channel support: default NCP cipher family (AES-256-GCM:AES-128-GCM). PSA table entries (crypto_mbedtls.c:93-95) are the mbedTLS cipher-selection surface consumed by cipher_kt_get; crypto_openssl.c:278-280 translate names for EVP fetch; mode queries in both backends. AEAD, Grover-only; not Shor-relevant

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live AES-128 support: data ciphers AES-128-GCM/CBC/CTR via the mbedTLS PSA selection table (crypto_mbedtls.c:93/98/103), OpenSSL name translation (crypto_openssl.c:278), DCO allowed-cipher lists (dco_freebsd.c:928 "none:AES-256-GCM:AES-192-GCM:AES-128-GCM:CHACHA20-POLY1305", dco_internal.h:42) and NCP defaults. 128-bit key, Grover-halved to 64-bit security; not Shor-relevant

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA3-224/256/384/512 selectable as --auth HMAC digests on mbedTLS builds: this name→PSA-alg table is consumed by the mbedTLS md_kt_get to instantiate the digest. PQ-relevant only via Grover, not Shor

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X509_digest with EVP_sha256 — the SHA-256 fingerprint path for --verify-hash pinning, preferred over the SHA-1 variant in the same file

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHAKE-128/256 are selectable as --auth HMAC digests: md_kt_get resolves any OpenSSL digest name via EVP_MD_fetch; the two sites are entries of the digest-name translation table kept for OCC wire-protocol compatibility. XOF, Grover-only, not Shor-relevant

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE2s256/BLAKE2b512 selectable as --auth HMAC digests via md_kt_get → EVP_MD_fetch on the OpenSSL backend; table entries exist for OCC name compatibility

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live AES-256 support: data ciphers AES-256-GCM/CTR/CBC via PSA selection table (crypto_mbedtls.c:95/100/105), OpenSSL fetch-name translation, and gen-sample-keys.sh:48 encrypts the sample client key with openssl rsa -aes256 (hardcoded pass 'password'). Symmetric, not Shor-relevant

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD data-channel support: PSA table entry (crypto_mbedtls.c:111), AEAD checks (crypto_mbedtls.c:240/273/382), legacy mbedTLS cipher check, and NCP default expansion adds it when available (ssl_ncp.c options_postprocess_setdefault_ncpciphers). Strong AEAD, Grover-only; not Shor-relevant

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Live --pkcs12 support: OpenVPN loads bundled cert+key from PKCS#12 files (ssl_openssl.c:922-949 d2i_PKCS12_bio/d2i_PKCS12_fp), option plumbing in options.c/check_file_access.c/options_show.c; gen-sample-keys.sh:52 exports the sample client.p12 with hardcoded password 'password' and -nodes (keys stored unencrypted inside the container). The keystore's own encryption (PKCS12 KDF/PBE) is what the collector's PKCS#12 class records

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenVPN's CSPRNG layer: rand_bytes() wraps OpenSSL RAND_bytes (crypto_openssl.c:550-554) / mbedTLS CTR-DRRBG (crypto_mbedtls.c:136) and feeds key generation, IVs and auth-token session IDs (auth_token.c:218). Correct posture: CSPRNG for all security randomness

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: gen-sample-keys.sh mints the entire sample PKI: RSA-4096 self-signed CA, RSA server/client certs, DSA certs from pregenerated DSA params, EC certs — the CSRs feed the sample CA whose keys/certs the tests and sample configs consume. Changeable here (sample/dev material, intentionally published)

components.name: OpenSSL (C) sessions on default settings (OpenSSL version unknown)

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenVPN's control-channel TLS sessions: ssl_openssl.c:107 creates the SSL_CTX with SSL_CTX_new_ex(tls_libctx, NULL, TLS_method()) — flexible method, version floor from --tls-version-min (default 1.2, ALG-a825c207), cipher list from --tls-cipher/--tls-ciphersuites, groups from --tls-groups/--ecdh-curve; custom libctx loads the xkey provider for external keys. On default settings sessions negotiate classic ECDHE (or ECDSA/RSA cert auth) — harvest-now-decrypt-later; NO post-quantum or hybrid group

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sample/sample-keys/client-pass.key: PKCS#8-encrypted client private key shipped in the repo so tests can exercise password-protected key loading (--askpass path). Sample/test material, intentionally published; changeable here

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sample/sample-keys/client.p12: PKCS#12 keystore (client cert + key) minted by gen-sample-keys.sh:52 (openssl pkcs12 -export -nodes -password pass:password) — sample artifact consumed by --pkcs12 tests; keys inside stored unencrypted (-nodes), container protected by the published password 'password'. Changeable here (sample material)
